column3: RYJ10151554 04/01/2018 XR Chest:  Clinical details: Known bronchiectasis.  Cough with phlegm.  Recent antibiotics.  Previous chest x-ray showed possible abnormality at the left lung base.  Report: Comparison is made with the previous chest radiograph of 29/11/2017.  The heart size and mediastinal contour are normal.  New areas of poorly defined increased opacity are present within the right lower zone associated with bronchial wall thickening consistent with an acute inflammatory exacerbation of the known airways disease.    The area of poorly defined increased opacity at the left lung base is longstanding and has been documented as being due to an area of chronic atelectasis within the inferior segment of the lingula.  It is slightly less prominent than on the previous radiograph suggesting that there was an additional inflammatory component at this site which has now improved.
